BROKEN_COLOR_LINK_HINT: Linked to the colour variable {name}, which no longer exists: keeps its last colour. Pick a colour to unlink it, or add a colour variable named {name} to link it again.
CLICK_TO_UNLINK_COLOR: Linked: click to unlink, keeping the colour
COLOR_LINKED_HINT: Linked to the colour variable {name}: follows it when it changes. Pick another colour to unlink it.
COLOR_VARIABLES_EMPTY: No colour variables yet. A colour picked from the colour variables stays linked to it and follows when it changes.
EFFECT_HUE_SATURATION_HINT: Shift colours around the colour wheel and change their intensity
EFFECT_TINT_HINT: Colour the image with one colour
ELEMENT_LINE_COLOR: Line colour, on screen and in the export
EXPORT_TILE_OVERLAP_HINT: Artwork printed on both neighbouring sheets, so one can be trimmed and glued over the other without a gap
EXPORT_TILE_POSITION_HINT: Moves the sheets over the page, from centred: to keep the joins out of the buttons, for instance. Sheets are added or left out so the page stays covered. You can also drag them on the preview
REMOVED_VARIABLE_USERS_ONE: It is used by {n} field or colour, which keeps its current value and shows a broken link icon.
REMOVED_VARIABLE_USERS_OTHER: It is used by {n} fields and colours, which keep their current values and show a broken link icon.
SAVE_COLOR_AS_VARIABLE_HINT: Adds a colour variable with this colour and links this colour to it
SAVE_COLOR_IN_USE: Double-click to save it as a colour variable
SHAPE_INNER_RADIUS_HINT: Distance of the inner corners from the centre, as a share of the points' distance
SHAPE_STROKE_WIDTH_HINT: Width of the line along the outline, centred on it; resizing the shape keeps it
SNAP_TO_ANCHORS_HINT: Image centres, corners and edge middles snap to the template's anchors while dragged. Hold Alt to drag freely.
SNAP_TO_EDGES_HINT: While moved or resized, layer edges and centres snap to the page's edges and centre, and to the template's outline: its edges, centre, straight sides and bleed line. Hold Alt to drag freely.
TEXT_PATH_RADIUS_HINT: Radius of the circle the first line's baseline follows. The layer is centred on the circle: snap its centre to a button's anchor to put the text around the button.
VARIABLES_EMPTY: No variables yet. Add one, then use it with a field's fx button, a colour picker or a text's link button.
